name: Thaidene Nëné National Park Reserve
policyReason: The park only requires dogs to be leashed and lists no bans.
summary: Dogs are allowed on a leash; never leave them unattended.

excerpts.quote: Keep your dog on a leash at all times and never leave it unattended.

dogRules.text: Keep dogs leashed and never unattended; dogs can trigger bear attacks.
Leash dogs near muskoxen, which can kill dogs.
